values.meaning: missing health fraction per regen unit (5%)
values.binNote: SettPassive.MissingHealthUnit = 0.01 is the 1% unit used inside the {7733e08c} calc; the wiki's 5% figure is 5x that unit and isn't a separate data row.

RightPunchBonus's base term reads an unresolved ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart; the linear 5-to-90 progression from the wiki matches a straightforward +5/level formula but the exact bin base values could not be independently confirmed.

mechanics.claim: Sett regenerates additional health based on his missing health, on top of normal regen.
mechanics.quote: regenerates additional health based on {{as|his '''missing''' health}}

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks alternate between a normal Left Punch and an empowered Right Punch, resetting to Left Punch if no Right Punch occurs for 2 seconds.
mechanics.quote: basic attacks alternate between his {{as|Left Punch|armor}} and a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}

mechanics.claim: The Right Punch's bonus damage can be life stolen from.
mechanics.quote: The bonus physical damage from the {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Right Punch does not grant bonus attack speed; instead its windup time is separately fixed to be much shorter, and this fixed windup is still affected by attack speed buffs not already active on the prior Left Punch.
mechanics.quote: does not grant {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, rather its windup is sped up and fixed
